note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because raw `meta` shapes vary between rounds: the datasets-server infers `meta` from `batch-r01.jsonl`, then cannot cast the two `batch-r02.jsonl` records that carry `meta.tags`. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present on 4262 of 9970 records; always a string where present

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success` on every record, plus `tests_passed`, `cost_steps`, `duration_min`, `retries`, `wasted_calls`, `residual`, `xfailed` and single-record extras

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `generator`, `round` on every record, plus `domain`, `stack`, `plant`, `shop`, `tags` on subsets

disclosures.summary: Two records carry `meta.tags` (a list of strings) that no other record has. They are the records the inferred schema died on; they are kept exactly as generated.

disclosures: Every record is a `long-horizon-coding-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6`. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.
